task.description: Product decision: `formatBytes` in `src/format-bytes.mjs` now reports SI units, where 1 KB = 1000 B, 1 MB = 1000 KB and 1 GB = 1000 MB, instead of binary ones. Formatting is otherwise unchanged. Update the existing tests in `test/format-bytes.test.mjs` to the new expected values — the old numbers are no longer correct by design.
